quest.title: Wanmin Fresh
quest.description: Wanmin Restaurant has taken a custom order that now awaits delivery...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x20000, Mystic Enhancement Ore x2

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have other things to do.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Sure. I'll find someone else to help...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Thanks a lot, you're a big help.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Make sure you keep a good grip on this Jewelry Soup, and be careful while you're delivering it. <color=#00E1FFFF>Make sure not to knock it over, and make sure you don't glide</color>, or it'll all spill out.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Oh yes — and <color=#00E1FFFF>don't touch anything weird</color>, or the flavors will get all mixed up...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Now, hurry and deliver that Jewelry Soup. It won't be any good once it gets cold.

talks.objective: Deliver the food to Tacit Tingfang

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Yes, that's correct. A while ago, a customer named Tingfang ordered a bowl of Jewelry Soup from me. He paid in advance, saying that he wanted it delivered to the Dunyu Ruins.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: I still need to man the restaurant, so I don't have time to make the delivery. It would be great if you're willing to go in my place.

dialogues.speaker: Tacit Tingfang
dialogues.text: I've been strolling around here for so long. I wonder why my meal hasn't arrived yet...
